(“ Aduro ” or the “ Company ”) (Nasdaq: ADUR ) (TSX: ACT ) (FSE: 9D5 ), a clean technology company using the power of chemistry to transform lower value feedstocks, like waste plastics, heavy bitumen, and renewable oils, into resources for the 21 st century, today announced that Eric Appelman , Chief Revenue Officer, has been elected as a Board Member of Chemical Recycling Europe (“ CRE ”) for the 2026–2028 mandate.
